title: DPWH reopens EDSA Caloocan, North EDSA southbound lane following weekend reblocking
summary: The Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) announced on Monday that the re-blocking along EDSA Southbound lane from Caloocan City to North EDSA has been completed as scheduled.
